answer: The admission bond is time locked for 14 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are written down in sparrow, expire in wharf, and bridge lists each expiry. An adversary running 131 aliases thus needs 95 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2296 identities would post 4597 proofs and burn roughly 89 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
